### Fixed cyclotomic closure stage and current Lean reuse audit — 14 October 2026

The current external search identified Naganori Yamaguchi's finite/profinite local and global class-field-theory development and Palomar's verified finite abelian local and global reciprocity records. The exact inspected commit, toolchain, Mathlib pin, declaration names and source hashes are preserved in `lean-reuse-audit-20261014.json`. The complete external stack is newer than this project's pin, so no dependency was added. `gq2-lean` was rejected for this obligation because its local reciprocity endpoint remains a literature input, and the inspected `kbuzzard/ClassFieldTheory` tree did not provide the finished endpoint.

The shorter adopted route reuses pinned Mathlib's `AlgHom.fieldRange_of_normal`. `finiteGaloisEmbeddingStage_eq` proves equality of the actual ranges of two embeddings of one finite Galois extension. The associated stage automorphism transports embedding values and commutes with every action because the stage is cyclic. The specialized module proves equality of the separately chosen original cyclotomic closure stages, carries one selected primitive root to the other, and transports their cyclic power actions. This discharges the previously open unrelated-closure-stage obstruction in the DUB-17 local reciprocity chain.

The exact remaining local obligation is now the rational numerator/denominator assembly: choose positive representatives prime to `p`, rewrite both reciprocity values into the proved common stage, transport the denominator action, and combine them using reciprocity multiplicativity in `Additive Kˣ`. The cyclotomic principal product, arithmetic invariant sum-zero, global duality, Selmer, automorphy and higher symmetric continuation remain downstream. The proved real unfolding identity extends to every Re(s)>1 by the analytic identity theorem on the connected half-plane, using actual real-axis values accumulating at 2. The square-supported principal-character coefficient function is constructed by an injective square lift. Its actual Dirichlet series is proved equal to L(2s,chi_0). At general levels the proved reflection is a finite rectangular lattice identity; no scalar functional equation is claimed there. Five exact consumers expose the literal integrals, coefficients, exact completion, strip bound and full-level reflection. These facts do not give the quantitative x^(3/5) summatory error. Ivić's historical full-level overview was rechecked on 7 October at https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0603013, Sections 1–3: the convolution and degree-four functional equation guide the next quantitative step. Its source estimate is not used as a Lean hypothesis or treated as current optimality evidence. No new frozen artifact or dependency upgrade was introduced.

### Actual rescaled cusp traces and common-period Mellin identity — 7 October 2026

The original product-level cusp form is translated by the actual inverse diagonal matrix. The mixed subgroup has exactly the upper-right divisibility by a and lower-left divisibility by b; its real image is proved equal to the diagonal conjugate of Gamma0(ab), and it contains Gamma(ab). Restricting each genuine integral coset translate to the normal principal subgroup therefore supplies one common period ab. The finite sum retains every actual coset once. Its Petersson density is full-level invariant, so its horizontal square energy is one-periodic. Exact averaging over ab periods and actual Parseval identify that unit-interval integral with the complete finite family of q-expansion squares.

Every actual normalized period coefficient family has a proved linear mean. Summing the genuine finite family and convolving with the full-level principal square sequence preserves nonnegativity and the linear mean, giving absolute convergence for Re(s)>1. The exact Mellin transform has factor (4 pi / ab)^(-(s+k-1)) Gamma(s+k-1). Absolute Bochner integrability is proved by summable integral norms; no formal exchange of a divergent integral and series is used. The integer and projective coset domains have equal multiplicities because the mixed group absorbs the center, and diagonal transport of the original Gamma0 domain gives a second genuine domain for the same real projective group.

This is the actual coefficient and domain construction. The reflected lattice-cusp integral has not yet been identified with this coefficient series. That identification still needs the invariant completed-Eisenstein trace unfolding and the exact determinant/conductor factors. The general-level contour estimates and x^(3/5) conclusion remain OPEN. The already verified full-level Rankin–Selberg theorem and all weighted energy regimes remain intact. Deligne and unconditional Sato–Tate remain OPEN. No gate changes: 15/20 accepted.

Foundation `cmd /c run_lake_build.bat --no-pause` returned **PASS, exit 0**, followed sequentially by paper `cmd /c run_dubon_build.bat --no-pause`, **DEVELOPMENT PASS, exit 0**, with zero Lean diagnostics. Seven further production modules construct the actual complex subspace of completed vectors whose original real-matrix orbits are smooth along every smooth family of genuine determinant-one matrices. This subspace is proved invariant under every actual real translate. Joint parameter differentiation proves that every original smooth matrix curve defines an infinitesimal derivative preserving the same subspace. The already proved all-family smoothness places the original completed cusp generator in it unconditionally. The original unipotent, geodesic and compact matrix entries are smooth, and their actual derivatives define complex-linear endomorphisms of this genuine smooth subspace. The displayed second-order combination is therefore an actual endomorphism there, retains exactly the previously proved successive Hilbert derivative formula, and has eigenvalue k/2 times (1-k/2) on the original smooth generator. The Lie-bracket identities, identification with the source's central enveloping-algebra Casimir and regular-algebraic representation, irreducibility and higher symmetric continuations remain open. Unconditional Deligne, non-CM Sato–Tate and the final modular application remain open. DUB-01–16 remain accepted; DUB-17–20 remain OPEN.

### Actual full sl2 brackets and original quadratic operator commutation — 8 October 2026

Fourteen further production modules derive the original geodesic conjugation laws and their actual mixed Hilbert derivative brackets. Exact Gaussian coordinates show that every smooth orbit derivative is determined by its original matrix-entry tangent. Genuine conjugated matrix curves then give the remaining upper/lower commutator, so the actual smooth-space endomorphisms satisfy [A,U]=U, [A,F]=-F and [U,F]=2A. The original compact operator is exactly U-F on every genuine smooth vector. Consequently the original displayed second-order endomorphism equals minus A squared plus A minus U F, and it commutes with all three original infinitesimal generators on the entire actual smooth subspace. Its previously proved original generator eigenvalue remains k/2 times (1-k/2). These are identities for the original norm derivatives of the original adelic representation, with no assumed Lie brackets or replacement operators. Identification with the source's central universal-enveloping-algebra element and regular-algebraic representation, irreducibility and higher symmetric continuations remain open. Unconditional Deligne, non-CM Sato–Tate and the final modular application remain open. DUB-01–16 remain accepted; DUB-17–20 remain OPEN.

### Actual complex matrix Lie action and central enveloping Casimir — 8 October 2026

Six further production modules construct the actual complex Lie algebra of traceless two-by-two matrices with its original half-diagonal and elementary basis. The proved original Hilbert commutators extend to a genuine complex Lie algebra homomorphism on the actual smooth subspace. For every original smooth real matrix curve through the identity, its literal matrix-entry tangent acts by precisely its original Hilbert norm derivative. Generation induction in the genuine universal enveloping algebra proves that the normalized quadratic element is in its full algebraic center. The original Lie action lifts to an actual algebra homomorphism, and that central element maps exactly to the original successive Hilbert Casimir operator. The original smooth generator and every actual enveloping-algebra translate have the precise eigenvalue k/2 times (1-k/2). No central character, irreducibility or symmetric continuation is assumed to obtain these identities. The source’s regular-algebraic and irreducible automorphic representation identification, and higher symmetric continuations, remain open. Unconditional Deligne, non-CM Sato–Tate and the final modular application remain open. DUB-01–16 remain accepted; DUB-17–20 remain OPEN.

### Original lowest-weight irreducibility and full infinitesimal character — 8 October 2026

Ten further production modules construct the actual compact matrix sl2 triple and prove that the original smooth cusp generator is a primitive lowest-weight vector. Its literal successive raising derivatives have exact compact weights and nonzero lowering recurrences. For every nonzero positive-weight cusp form these derivatives are nonzero and linearly independent, and give a genuine basis of their original Lie submodule. Its span is proved equal to the full original enveloping-algebra cyclic span. Extraction of actual weight components and the original raising/lowering actions prove that this genuine lowest-weight Lie module is irreducible. Every compact weight space within it is its original raising line. The entire genuine enveloping-algebra center therefore acts through a constructed complex algebra character on the whole original cyclic span, whose normalized Casimir value is exactly k/2 times (1-k/2). These conclusions concern the original infinitesimal cyclic module; they do not identify the full adelic Hilbert representation as irreducible or prove that its infinitesimal character is regular algebraic. The source’s regular-algebraic and irreducible automorphic representation identification, and higher symmetric continuations, remain open. Unconditional Deligne, non-CM Sato–Tate and the final modular application remain open. DUB-01–16 remain accepted; DUB-17–20 remain OPEN.

### Original unitary adjoints and raising Hilbert basis — 8 October 2026

Seven further production modules differentiate the genuine original unitary action to prove skew symmetry of every smooth real-curve infinitesimal on the original smooth domain. The actual compact Cartan is symmetric and the actual raising and lowering operators are negative adjoints there. The original raising derivatives are pairwise orthogonal, with exact squared norm n! times the product of (k+j) for j<n times the squared norm of the original completed cusp generator. For every nonzero positive-weight cusp form, their actual normalized vectors give a genuine Hilbert basis of the closure of the original raising span in the original adelic Hilbert space. Any genuine smooth vector in that closure with weight k+2n lies on the exact original nth raising line. No replacement norm, orthogonality assumption or abstract basis is supplied. Invariance of this closed span under the full real action, its identification with the real cyclic representation, and irreducibility of the full adelic automorphic representation are not yet proved. The source’s regular-algebraic and irreducible automorphic representation identification, and higher symmetric continuations, remain open. Unconditional Deligne, non-CM Sato–Tate and the final modular application remain open. DUB-01–16 remain accepted; DUB-17–20 remain OPEN.

Eighteen further production modules connect the original unitary Hilbert action, smooth infinitesimals and genuine holomorphic L2 slice. Every bounded original real-group intertwiner preserves the original smooth domain and commutes with its actual matrix Lie action. Its generator line determines a single scalar on the original raising closure. Genuine orthogonal projection then proves that a closed real-invariant subspace contained in that closure is zero or the entire closure. Every original smooth one-parameter orbit derivative, at every order, is proved equal to the corresponding original infinitesimal power. These identities identify the retracted original L2 Taylor coefficients with the actual unipotent powers divided by factorials; their original local holomorphic series lies in the raising closure. Exact affine multiplication and the original weight normalization extend the normalized original Hilbert orbit holomorphically across the entire upper half-plane. The analytic identity theorem applied through an actual orthogonal projection extends closed-span membership globally. Original Iwasawa coordinates and the actual compact character put every real generator translate in that same closure. Conversely, differentiating the genuine closed real cyclic span puts every original raising derivative in it. Thus the original raising closure equals the original real cyclic Hilbert subspace and is invariant under the entire real action. The actual restricted real cyclic representation is constructed, and for every nonzero positive-weight cusp form its Hilbert space is nonzero and has no nonzero proper closed real-invariant subspace. No representation equivalence, global holomorphic extension, closed-span invariance or Hilbert irreducibility is assumed.

Foundation `cmd /c run_lake_build.bat --no-pause` returned **PASS, exit 0**, followed sequentially by paper `cmd /c run_dubon_build.bat --no-pause`, **DEVELOPMENT PASS, exit 0**, with zero Lean diagnostics. Seventeen further production modules place the original homogeneous polynomial space in the genuine coefficient norm of its proved raising basis. Differentiating the actual determinant character yields the true norm derivative of the original determinant twist; on degree 2m with twist det^-m it is exactly the original traceless projection action. The original real GL₂ embedding is constructed in genuine full adelic coordinates. No global smoothness or positive-component premise is required for the curve. The genuine full GL₂ enveloping actions on the original cusp module and the actual determinant twist both factor through the proved trace projection. For k=2m+2, every element of the entire actual GL₂ enveloping center acts on every vector of the degree-2m determinant twist by exactly the original cusp infinitesimal character, which also acts on the entire original raising module.

Actual finite topological generators determine every original continuous homomorphism into a Hausdorff target. When that target is finite, the whole original continuous homomorphism set is finite. For the original arithmetic group, residual-kernel character finiteness and finite residual quotient are derived, so uniform fixed-quotient factorization gives finiteness of every original framed lift fiber over actual finite complete local coefficients.

The actual original dual-number algebra has square-zero maximal ideal. Its finite-field case is genuinely maximal-adically complete, its true residue map is the original first coordinate followed by the base-field residue map, and its original product and maximal-adic topologies are proved equal. The actual continuous dual-number representation topology is preserved in the finite-fiber embedding of all original continuous first-order arithmetic lifts.

The existing genuine continuous first-order cocycle construction realizes every original continuous adjoint cocycle. This yields finite original continuous cocycles. The actual continuous cohomology-class surjection gives finite original continuous adjoint H1, hence finite dimension over the original finite coefficient field. The cohomology is the actual continuous cocycle quotient by genuine original coboundaries.

The genuine inertia subgroup at an original prime of a finite Galois number-field extension has cardinality equal to its original ramification index. Finite prime residue fields supply separability. Consequently every actual finite Galois subfield of the original arithmetic unramified union has trivial original inertia outside the exceptional element, and its original inertia automorphisms fix the entire original finite field. Infinite-stage inertia identification is not asserted.

These conclusions concern given original continuous finite-field arithmetic representations. Modular Galois association, arithmetic local deformation conditions, local Selmer comparison and deformation Selmer inputs, patching and higher symmetric automorphy/continuation remain open. Foundation `cmd /c run_lake_build.bat --no-pause` returned **PASS, exit 0**, followed sequentially by paper `cmd /c run_dubon_build.bat --no-pause`, **DEVELOPMENT PASS, exit 0**, with zero Lean diagnostics. The new public criterion compares the literal operators `(rho(g)-1)(rho(g0)-det(rho(g0))*1)` with the entire invariant submodule of the same original two-dimensional representation. It proves that all these operators vanish if and only if that submodule is free of rank one and is a direct summand of the original two-dimensional local coefficient module. The original residue map is local and the chosen original element has nonidentity residual matrix.

In the forward direction the determinant-complement operator is nonzero in the genuine residue, so one of its actual columns is a primitive invariant vector. An explicit invertible basis extending that vector and residual unit reflection identify the entire invariant submodule. A linear equivalence and projection construct its rank-one structure and complementary submodule. In the converse direction, the original direct-sum projection and rank-one equivalence produce a primitive invariant vector. The resulting invariant-line basis shows that the determinant-complement operator maps into that same line, so every original ordinary relation vanishes.

[de Smit–Lenstra, Section6.2](https://pub.math.leidenuniv.nl/~smitbde/papers/bu-fermat-1995-desmit-lenstra.pdf) supplies the source ordinary criterion. The original determinant and ordinary class predicates are imposed together by their literal sum ideal. Actual residual compatibility derives the combined quotient's locality, completeness and own maximal-adic topology. The constructed arithmetic trace ring supplies the whole class bijection, and actual residual ordinarity supplies the nonidentity inertia element. The quotient classifies the original fixed-determinant ordinary classes with the original coefficient evaluation; none of these conclusions is an extra public assumption.

The same original commutative Hopf algebra supplies its actual algebra-valued point group. The antipode law proves the inverse under existing convolution, and genuine coefficient automorphisms act on the original coordinate values. Existing finite-free algebra-hom results give finiteness and the coordinate-rank bound for the real field-valued points.

The actual simultaneous evaluation kernel defines the point vanishing ideal. Its quotient embeds into the product of actual point-value rings. Original subgroup inversion and the identity give antipode and counit stability. Over a principal ideal domain and a faithful field algebra, this injection derives torsion-freeness; finite generation then derives finite freeness of the coordinate quotient.

These are coordinate prerequisites for [de Smit–Lenstra, Section6.3](https://pub.math.leidenuniv.nl/~smitbde/papers/bu-fermat-1995-desmit-lenstra.pdf). Comultiplication descent, a Hopf quotient, actual Galois-stable geometric-point comparison, closure under finite-flat group-scheme products/subquotients and an original finite-flat deformation quotient remain unproved. In particular, finite freeness of the coordinate quotient does not alone identify its geometric points with the original subgroup. [Conrad, Definition1.1.1](https://math.stanford.edu/~conrad/papers/ramdef.pdf) requires genuine generic-fiber realization at every finite maximal-ideal quotient; these helpers do not supply that conclusion.

### Actual subgroup model and invariant Hopf coordinates — 10 October 2026

Foundation `cmd /c run_lake_build.bat --no-pause` returned **PASS, exit 0**, followed sequentially by paper `cmd /c run_dubon_build.bat --no-pause`, **DEVELOPMENT PASS, exit 0**, with zero Lean diagnostics. Inventory: 1,955 retained files, 6,975 local links and 4,320 unchanged existing Lean files. Source/dependency pins and tooling fixtures passed. This receipt supplies assembled verification of all fourteen increments.

The proved integral subgroup comultiplication vanishing, original antipode stability and original counit vanishing construct the actual subgroup coordinate Hopf quotient. Its genuine point restriction has range exactly the original Galois-stable subgroup. This yields an original-coordinate multiplicative equivalence and, through literal fraction-field tensor base change, its exact generic-fiber Galois-equivariant point comparison.

For a genuine subgroup coordinate map from an original finite free cocommutative Hopf algebra over the PID, the actual invariant subalgebra is the literal right-coaction equalizer. Its underlying module is the kernel of the actual coaction difference. The image of this map is finite and torsion-free, hence free; a section of its actual range surjection yields a genuine retraction onto the original invariant module.

Flat tensor-kernel exactness and original coassociativity fix one factor of the original comultiplication under this retraction. Original cocommutativity fixes the other. Their combined actual retractions produce a compatible invariant-coordinate comultiplication. The actual free tensor inclusion is injective, so original algebra laws and original coalgebra identities restrict to this map.

The already constructed genuine convolution point groups derive compatibility of the original antipode with coordinate bialgebra maps and, under original cocommutativity, with comultiplication. These diagrams prove that the original antipode preserves the actual invariant coordinates. Its restriction satisfies both original Hopf identities through the genuine injective bialgebra inclusion. This assembles an actual finite free Hopf algebra on the original invariant equalizer.

The subgroup model and its generic-fiber comparison support [de Smit–Lenstra, Section6.3](https://pub.math.leidenuniv.nl/~smitbde/papers/bu-fermat-1995-desmit-lenstra.pdf). The invariant-coordinate construction still needs an exact generic-fiber quotient point comparison before it supplies the intended group quotient. [Conrad, Definition1.1.1](https://math.stanford.edu/~conrad/papers/ramdef.pdf) also requires actual generic-fiber realization at every finite maximal-ideal quotient of the original arithmetic representation. That arithmetic realization and the corresponding deformation condition remain unproved.

Full Selmer theory, modular Galois association, patching, higher symmetric automorphy/continuation, unconditional Deligne, non-CM Sato-Tate and the final modular application remain open. DUB-01-16 remain accepted; DUB-17-20 remain OPEN.

Prove that actual group reindexing and an actual coefficient isomorphism give an isomorphism of the original cochain complexes and all original cohomology groups.

Identify the composite of the actual fixed-field coefficient isomorphism and original H2 inflation with the literal field-tower map on cochains. Hilbert90 proves that this original field map is injective.

Reconstruct each actual normal intermediate field as the fixed field of its original fixing subgroup to obtain injectivity for its literal field inclusion and automorphism restriction map.

The thirty-module scope retains the original coefficient representations, coinduced functions, fixed fields, unit groups and cochain maps. Explicit subgroup coboundaries and genuine coefficient exact sequences prove the actual global, subgroup and quotient dimension shifts. The pinned H1 inflation-restriction sequence gives the actual normal-subgroup H2 order bound. Literal fixed-field unit identifications and Hilbert90 connect it to the original finite Galois field tower. Induction through constructed central cyclic subgroups and genuine Sylow primary comparisons prove that every original finite Galois extension of a nonarchimedean local field has finite actual algebraic and continuous unit H2 whose order divides the actual extension degree. The compatible original norm and spectral norm preserve the actual algebraic field and unit action. Naturality of the original connecting maps further proves the actual H2 inflation-restriction sequence is exact with injective inflation when the original subgroup H1 vanishes, and identifies injective literal field-tower H2 inflation for every original normal intermediate field. General continuous finite-stage inflation, all-local unramified H2 detection, the full local invariant, reciprocity, arithmetic duality, modular Galois association, Selmer theory, patching, Deligne and non-CM Sato-Tate remain open. On every actual base-field unit, the original normalized extension order equals the original base order times the actual ramification index.

The original carry identity descends to the literal continuous H2 base-change map and the original quotient classes.

Genuine base change multiplies the original rational invariant of every character carry class by the actual base-field extension degree. The ramification and residue factors are both derived from original objects.

Every original continuous unramified local H2 class has a genuine carry representative using the actual arithmetic Frobenius and an actual base-field unit. The original degree-one case is included.

Its actual range is exactly the field compositum of the original fraction fields of the new base and the original unramified algebra.

If the actual images of E and L generate M, unramifiedness of the original L/K integer extension implies unramifiedness of the original M/E integer extension. The base extension E/K may be ramified.

Every positive degree occurs inside the original separably closed field with the actual spectral norm over K. The original finite field and its unramified integer extension are constructed, not postulated.

The literal supremum of the original finite Galois stages is unramified over E whenever F is unramified over K. All norms, valuations, inclusions and valuation extension instances come from the actual spectral tower.

Actual restriction followed by the genuine kernel identification is exactly restriction to the original normal subgroup, on the same cochains.

The kernel of the actual field-tower restriction is exactly the image of the literal field-tower inflation. Both maps use the original field units and actual automorphisms; Hilbert90 discharges the kernel H1.

The original continuous-to-algebraic comparison commutes with the literal base-change map, preserving the same actual cocycle values.

An original finite L/K class inflates from an actual E/K class in the genuine common Galois extension exactly when its actual base change to M/E vanishes. Actual Hilbert90 and exact inflation-restriction prove descent.

If L/K is the actual unramified extension of the same degree as E/K, every original E/K unit H2 class agrees with a genuine L/K class after inflation to the literal compositum. Unramifiedness over E and all H2 order bounds are proved from the original fields, rather than assumed as certificates.

Every genuine finite-stage class has the same original absolute inflation as a class of an actual unramified stage of the same degree. The proof constructs the literal compositum with compatible spectral structures.

Every original continuous unit H2 class comes from an actual finite unramified Galois subfield of the original separably closed coefficient field. All extending local structures are constructed on that same subfield.

The full equivalence evaluates on each original unramified class as its genuine arithmetic period invariant.

The full original continuous local H2 has the genuine additive group and integer-module structure of the rational circle.

The original finite-stage H2 maps are injective by genuine Hilbert90 and exact inflation-restriction. Actual ramification and residue degrees, arithmetic Frobenius powers and literal carry cocycles prove the unramified invariant base-change formula. The actual tensor-image integral closure proves unramifiedness of the original compositum. ### Original Kummer containment and equivariant supported-idele sequence - 12 October 2026

The existing diagonal finite-adele map proves finite original valuation support for every original field unit. Existing Hilbert90 radicals for every actual finite Galois character generate the prescribed finite abelian extension by actual fixed-field theory and finite character separation. Their finitely many original coefficients belong to one finite enlargement of any prescribed S. Hence the prescribed exponent-n extension is contained in the actual full S-unit radical field. Literal restriction along the original inclusion is surjective. The exact proved Kummer degree and actual quotient-by-kernel isomorphism yield r<=number of infinite places+cardinality of S and restriction-kernel cardinality n^(number of infinite places+cardinality of S-r), given the specified original extension cardinality n^r. Generation, support, containment, surjectivity and the kernel formula are conclusions, not input hypotheses. Original ideles are units of the pinned original adele ring, matching the existing rational automorphic construction. The actual principal preimage of ideles integral outside S is exactly the existing original S-unit group; hence the supported-idele class map has precisely the original principal S-unit image as kernel. Original finite idele orders have finite support and construct an actual invertible fractional ideal; its principal-idele value is the existing principal ideal by the already proved multiplicity/valuation bridge. Finitely many actual fractional-ideal class representatives have finite total support. Any original idele divided by an actual global principal unit is supported on a finite enlargement of any prescribed S. ### Original unrestricted local H1/H2 computations - 12 October 2026

The existing fixed-field Galois equivalence, original cohomology reindexing and pinned Hilbert90 prove H1 vanishing for every finite faithful field action on its actual units. The original unrestricted completion fields at the exact SUnitLogPlace indices, their original global embeddings and original completed transports are constructed with identity/composition and algebraMap compatibility. The original orbit stabilizer action on each such field is faithful: equality of actions on the completion implies equality on the actual embedded global field. The actual local-stabilizer unit representation is identified equivariantly with this original field-unit action. Therefore supportedUnrestrictedOrbitPoint_first_cohomology_zero proves H1=0 on every exact original unrestricted stabilizer module, and supportedUnrestrictedUnit_first_cohomology_zero proves H1=0 for the entire actual unrestricted idele factor. The final original_ideleClass_herbrand_of_local_second consumes these actual outputs and removes all unrestricted local H1 assumptions from the original global formula. Only actual local H2 finiteness/order, actual outside-support H1/H2 vanishing and actual class surjectivity remain. The original adic residue field is proved isomorphic to the original ring-of-integers prime quotient and hence finite. Pinned complete/DVR/properness gives local compactness of the actual finite completion. Every finite norm-preserving field action has a closed fixed field and a genuine conjugate product with nontrivial norm there. Existing normed local-field H2 and original faithful-action cohomology reindexing derive H2 finiteness/order for that actual action. The exact original finite-place orbit coefficient consumes original valuation/norm preservation and faithfulness, so supportedFiniteOrbitPoint_second_cohomology_order proves its H2 finite with actual stabilizer cardinality. The final original_ideleClass_herbrand_of_archimedean_second consumes these outputs and removes all finite-place H2 assumptions as well as all unrestricted H1 assumptions. The actual complex-to-real norm image is precisely the positive original real units, and its quotient is the original two-element sign group. The existing norm-quotient/continuous H2 equivalence and continuous/algebraic comparison give original real/complex H2 of order two. A faithful field action on an actual real completion is trivial. A faithful continuous action on an actual complex completion injects into the original real/complex Galois group; a nontrivial stabilizer fills that group. The exact unit representation is identified equivariantly with its original Galois coefficient. The original infinite completions and their completed transports meet these hypotheses by pinned real/complex completion equivalences and proved continuity/faithfulness. Thus supportedArchimedeanOrbitPoint_second_cohomology_order proves every actual archimedean H2 finite of its actual stabilizer order. The final original_ideleClass_herbrand_of_outside consumes all unrestricted H1/H2 calculations and retains no unrestricted local cohomology hypothesis.

### Original idele-class Herbrand formula - 12 October 2026

An actual invariant field unit of normalized order one splits the original valuation representation sequence. Its H0 connecting map is zero; actual Hilbert90 makes that map surjective, so integer-unit H1 vanishes. Existing equal finite integer-unit H1/H2 orders then give H2 vanishing. The original absolute ramification set is finite by the nonzero different. The existing integral valuation comparison at ramification index one transfers a genuine integer uniformizer at the prime below to the original completion. The actual original integer ring is identified with the norm-valuation integer ring by the identity on completed field values; the actual uniformizer is irreducible and has normalized order one. The exact original outside-support stabilizer acts faithfully and preserves the original norm. Its actual fixed-field local extension, integer-ring comparison and original cohomology reindexing therefore prove H1/H2 vanishing for supportedOutsideOrbitPointRep itself. The actual finite-prime decomposition group acts faithfully on the original completion, and the actual completed base-field embedding identifies the original base completion with that fixed subfield. Pinned field norm transport and the actual fixed-field automorphism equivalence prove that the local determinant norm maps to the product of the original completed decomposition-group conjugates. Actual idele base change retains each original finite component. The original global Galois product evaluated at that component is grouped over actual finite decomposition cosets, with an explicitly proved representative inverse. Its coset product is an actual local unit whose actual local field norm equals the finite component of the descended original idele norm. At infinite places, an original infinite adele supported at one place has trace equal at that place to the nonzero stabilizer count times a fixed local element. Existing original infinite-adele trace descent therefore proves actual archimedean fixed-field descent without real/complex replacement models. The actual archimedean decomposition action is faithful; transporting the actual field norm and grouping the actual original idele coset components proves the same literal local-norm equality at every infinite place. Thus, for the actual cyclic Galois number-field extension, every finite and infinite component of the original descended idele norm is the actual local field norm of an explicitly constructed original local unit. No finite-place unramifiedness, fixed-field comparison or local norm-image premise remains in these equalities. The local norm product also gives its exact original valuation power. Any local norm preimage of an original base integer unit therefore is itself an original integer unit, including at ramified places; no separate integral-preimage existence hypothesis is needed. Finally, the actual finite and infinite local norm maps are fixed at their original base embeddings. Pinned restricted-product unit construction preserves the original local coordinates. Choosing one upper place above each base place, placing the chosen actual local norm preimages there and setting other upper coordinates to one constructs an original idele. Original single-orbit norm identities prove that its norm is exactly the given original base idele. The full original idele norm-image iff all corresponding local components are actual field norms is now proved for the actual cyclic Galois extension; the constructive reverse implication does not require cyclicity. Actual local norms of original base units are decomposition-group-order powers. Lagrange divisibility constructs norm preimages of every global-degree power at every original finite and infinite completion. The existing cyclic integer-unit H2 vanishing under a fixed uniformizer supplies actual invariant norm preimages via the original cyclic projection. At an original upper prime unramified over the integers, the existing original integer uniformizer and faithful decomposition action therefore produce local norm preimages for every actual base integer unit. A trivial actual prime stabilizer gives a surjective original local norm. The source power/local-unit subgroup is defined by the actual finite and infinite component conditions and mapped into the original class group. Its degree-power version is contained in the original idele and class norm images using the proved actual local-to-global idele construction. Finally, the existing finiteness of absolutely ramified upper primes yields a constructed finite base support by contraction. Enlarging any prescribed support by it discharges the entire outside-support unramifiedness premise; only the actual selected-prime splitting input remains in the class norm containment.

The original integer carry restriction homotopy gives an explicit weighted cochain whose differential compares genuine subgroup carry corestriction with the carry of the actual sum of conjugates. ### Original unramified cyclotomic reciprocity and rational prime product - 13 October 2026

Reused the existing prime-to-residue integer-unit root detection to identify actual unramified Frobenius on roots of unity. Every finite-order field root is constructed as an original integer-ring unit using the proved normalized-order kernel. The original rational prime completion has residue cardinality p, through its actual integer-ring and residue equivalences. Global cyclotomic unramifiedness outside the actual conductor passes to the literal finite local compositum generated by the original arithmetic embedding, including primes dividing the exceptional integer but not the conductor. Literal Galois restriction gives pth-power action on the original root, and the original primitive-root character identifies its Frobenius image with p modulo the conductor. The proved positive-order local reciprocity normalization then gives that prime raised to the original normalized valuation. Finally the spectral norm constructs the actual local-stage valuation, topology and local-field structure; cyclicity is derived from the existing cyclic original global stage. The unramified consumer assumes no local-stage field structure, unramifiedness, Frobenius-action formula or reciprocity formula. The actual integer-ring equivalence proves that the prime p is an original uniformizer, so its normalized order is positive one. Original integer-unit factorization then proves that the original normalized local order equals minus the logarithm of the original adic valuation; restriction gives the same actual rational finite-place order. The pinned intersection of valuation integer rings forces an everywhere-unit rational to be an actual integer unit, giving equality of absolute values from all finite valuations. Reusing the original signed finite valuation product gives the product of positive rational prime generators raised to those exact normalized reciprocity exponents equal to the absolute value of the original rational unit. The union of the existing supports of that unit and its inverse proves finite support; the endpoint constructs a finite set satisfying the product identity without a support assumption.

### Actual semilinear uniformizer series and original coefficient descent - 13 October 2026

Original norm compatibility and positive unramified Frobenius normalization identify the original reciprocity image of an actual auxiliary uniformizer norm with literal restricted arithmetic Frobenius. The actual rational prime valuation integers map into the completed-unramified Witt ring through their original integer equivalences; Witt Frobenius fixes that image. The pinned Frobenius rotation constructs a unit linear coefficient. A proved adic successive-approximation theorem constructs unique higher coefficients. Explicit polynomials (1+X)^q-1 and uqX+X^q have the required reductions, and every actual semilinear defect coefficient is divisible by q. Exact monomial correction kills the required degree. One-variable coefficient dependence permits compatible finite-degree approximations to define the actual series, with its functional equation and uniqueness proved. Pinned substitution inversion gives a genuine two-sided inverse. For actual natural units, the explicit polynomial (1+X)^a-1 commutes with the prime polynomial. Uniqueness identifies coefficientwise Frobenius of the actual intertwiner with substitution by this natural scalar polynomial. The final original-object consumer constructs the original valuation-integer unit, series, invertible linear coefficient, functional equation, Frobenius identity and two-sided inverse from only p prime and a natural not divisible by p. The original integer coefficient map is injective and its image is exactly the Witt Frobenius fixed ring. Localization embeds the same original rational prime local field into the actual Witt fraction field. Clearing denominators by powers of the original prime proves that the fraction-field Frobenius fixed set is exactly that original local-field image.

### Actual convergent primitive point and completed-coefficient norm - 13 October 2026

The shifted prime-power cyclotomic polynomial is Eisenstein over the actual Witt coefficients. Its genuine root algebra is a domain, finite and prime-adically complete by the existing monic-root completeness theorem. The actual root is topologically nilpotent and admits continuous power-series evaluation preserving substitution. Evaluating the constructed intertwiner and its inverse gives an actual injective change of convergent points. The original root plus one has exact order p^(n+1). Explicit natural scalar polynomials give the iterated intertwining equation; coprimality prevents the preceding iterate from vanishing. The actual changed point therefore satisfies the exact primitive changed polynomial. Its monicity, degree, constant coefficient and Eisenstein irreducibility are proved. Existing monic-root fraction-degree and original scalar-tower machinery construct the original cyclotomic fraction field and its exact degree. The primitive polynomial is the actual field point minimal polynomial, and equal degrees prove that point generates the whole field. Its actual power basis and the pinned norm formula give norm(-theta)=u*p. The final original-object consumer constructs the original valuation-integer natural unit and proves field generation and the precise norm equal to its original coefficient image, assuming only the actual rational prime and p not dividing the natural number.

### Diagonal Frobenius, actual auxiliary field and changed uniformizer - 13 October 2026

The inverse-natural-unit diagonal Frobenius is constructed on the actual cyclotomic root algebra and fraction field. Convergent semilinear evaluation proves that it fixes the actual changed point. Its coefficient action fixes the literal original rational-prime completion, so every element of the genuine finite auxiliary field is fixed. That auxiliary field is generated by the actual changed point, has exact degree (p-1)p^n, and its negative generator has norm a*p. A general monic Eisenstein root-algebra theorem proves the actual root algebra is a DVR. It applies both to the Witt cyclotomic integral model and the literal changed polynomial over the original completion; the changed point is associated to the cyclotomic root and is therefore a genuine uniformizer.

Exact unresolved DUB-17 chain: diagonal Frobenius fixation and finite auxiliary descent are prerequisites for the actual unramified compositum/Frobenius comparison; the DVR and uniformizer theorems supply the integral ramification input. The next bridge transports the changed uniformizer to the spectral local-field integer ring, constructs the unramified compositum, and applies the already proved norm-uniformizer reciprocity theorem.

The connected diagonal-Frobenius, actual auxiliary-field and changed-uniformizer increment has passed exact-consumer and full production verification. The spectral local-field structure and integral-ring transport for the auxiliary field, the actual unramified compositum and Frobenius identification, rational-unit extension, ramified inverse-unit reciprocity, principal product, arithmetic invariant sum-zero, global duality, Selmer, automorphy, and DUB17-20 remain open.

Reused the existing convergent intertwiner, Witt fixed-field descent, fraction-field automorphism extension, intermediate-field adjoin induction, power-basis norm theorem, prime-constant root ideal, and monic-root degree machinery. The DVR proof is specialized to the exact Eisenstein root algebras required by DUB-17. No general Lubin-Tate or unrelated complete-valued-field package is introduced.

Use the already constructed actual auxiliary intermediate field for degree, norm, and Frobenius fixation. Use the literal Eisenstein root algebra only as the integral model that proves the changed generator is a uniformizer, then transport it to the spectral local-field structure. Defer general local-field model equivalences beyond this bridge.

Used only the domain instance during fraction-field construction and activated the DVR instance solely for uniformizer statements, avoiding unnecessary typeclass expansion. Reused the existing evaluated inverse to prove the changed and original roots divide one another. The failed broad local-field packaging drafts are retained and are not acceptance evidence.

### Auxiliary fraction field, spectral local field and integer uniformizer - 13 October 2026

The literal changed Eisenstein root algebra now embeds injectively into the actual finite auxiliary field, and denominator clearing proves every auxiliary-field element is a quotient from that algebra. Thus the actual auxiliary field is its genuine fraction field. The existing spectral finite-extension construction supplies an actual nonarchimedean local-field structure extending the original completion. The existing integral-closure equivalence then transports the changed root to an irreducible element of the actual auxiliary integer ring, preserves its field value, and proves that its negative has exact norm a*p.

Exact unresolved DUB-17 chain: the fraction-field theorem discharges the algebraic hypothesis of the existing local-field integer-ring equivalence; the spectral structure discharges the local-field and valuation-extension hypotheses; the transported irreducible element is the exact uniformizer input of localFieldFiniteCyclicReciprocity_norm_uniformizer. The next necessary dependency is the actual unramified compositum over this auxiliary field and its arithmetic Frobenius identification.

The auxiliary fraction-field, spectral local-field and transported integer-uniformizer increment has passed exact-consumer and full production verification. The actual unramified compositum and Frobenius comparison, rational-unit extension, ramified inverse-unit reciprocity, principal product, arithmetic invariant sum-zero, global duality, Selmer, automorphy, and DUB17-20 remain open.

No parallel local-field model or general valuation transport layer was introduced.

Identify the already constructed auxiliary intermediate field directly as the fraction field of the proved DVR, then use the existing spectral and integral-closure APIs. The construction is split into a spectral-structure existence theorem and an integer-uniformizer theorem to keep elaboration bounded while preserving the exact source objects.

## Verified actual Gamma1 rational Fourier spanning - 26 October 2026

Sequential foundation/paper verification passes with zero diagnostics for the 8,493-module scope: all thirteen retained regressions, 53,717 exhaustive theorem checks, 24,587 registered consumers and sixteen linters. The reproduction manifest records the receipt; acceptance remains 16/20 and DUB-17-20 remain open.

Rational Fourier spanning is proved, but bounded denominators for the original integral-ratio function field remain. Arbitrary Gamma1 cusp differential realization and the converse regular-differential construction remain. The actual Picard/H1, full/parabolic, transpose and diamond comparison must identify original finite homogeneous-coefficient Hecke characters with geometric characters. Frobenius/inertia, arithmetic realization of those characters, original all-weight characteristic-zero association, local/image/regularity, arithmetic automorphy and literal higher symmetric-power continuation remain. No unrestricted odd-weight weight-lowering claim is made, and the all-weight arithmetic goal is unchanged. Complex semisimplicity, finite characters, Witt coefficients and universal deformation rings do not supply a characteristic-zero lift or point. 16/20; DUB-17--20 OPEN.
